category_edits.rationale: Scale chronological positional contributions by 0.75 across all four category models to test whether softer positional influence improves generalization. Preserve position IDs, embedding parameterization, histories, backbone, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports this same model class, so masked training and appended-mask inference use identical scaling without checkpoint shape changes.

change_summary: Reduce chronological positional embedding contributions to 0.75 in the shared BERT4Rec encoder used by training and prediction.
